name: Awei PC-2 Mini Stereo Wired In-ear Earphone
description:
AWEI PC-2 Earphones
Features:
Built-in high-quality drivers for powerful bass and immersive sound.
HiFi sound decoding technology for excellent audio quality.
Lightweight and comfortable mini in-ear design.
Specifications:
Sensitivity: 92 ± 3
Frequency Response Range: 20-20,000Hz
Plug Diameter: 3.5mm
Cable Length: 1.2 meters
Experience stunning lows and clear, powerful beats with the AWEI PC-2 Earphones. Perfect for immersive listening wherever you go.
